title: Musk and other tech executives sign joint petition demanding Nvidia reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
excerpt: Reported on November 14, Elon Musk and other tech company executives co-signed a petition calling on Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO. As of Satu
content_html:
Reported on November 14, Elon Musk and other tech company executives co-signed a petition calling on Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO. As of Saturday afternoon, the petition had received more than 115,000 signatures, including 5,965 current Nvidia employees, 1,108 former employees, and 63,063 shareholders.

Public supporters also include Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Replit CEO Amjad Masad, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan. The petition expressed concern over Huang's removal without due process, demanding that the board reinstate him during an independent investigation and ensure the investigation is fair and more information is disclosed to the public.

Previously, Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO on November 12. Nvidia subsequently appointed Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as interim CEO and launched a search for a permanent successor. Huang's departure has drawn market attention, with Nvidia's stock price falling sharply this week. His departure could also affect the financing ecosystem for AI startups and investment activity in the industry.

The joint petition reflects Huang's influence within Nvidia and across the global technology industry, and has further turned this senior management change into a broad event involving corporate governance, capital markets, and the AI industry ecosystem.
